WHAT IS A NATION?
A nation is not a casual or ephemeral conglomeration. It is a
stable community. But stable communities (like the Austrian
or Russian states) are not automatically nations.
To qualify as a true nation, a community must possess
five specific, interdependent pillars.

PILLAR 4: INTERNAL ECONOMIC COHESION
Common territory alone is insufficient. An internal economic bond
must weld the various parts into a single whole.

THE ENGINE OF THE NATIONAL MOVEMENT
The national movement belongs to the epoch of rising capitalism. Its primary architect is the bourgeoisie.
